assetScope: explicit Shanghai/Shenzhen stock, ETF or exchange index; one symbol
dataSource: Sina documented stock_zh_a_minute contract by default; explicit --provider eastmoney retains Eastmoney adapter. No silent cross-provider fallback.

request.dates: optional comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD, restricted to returned sessions
request.columns: optional 1..4 maximum desktop columns; JEV chooses balanced rowCounts after actual data count

dataContract.interval: Actual source resolution: 1m or explicitly labeled 5m
dataContract.volumeUnit: Sina: source-unverified and volume subchart hidden; Eastmoney: lots converted to shares

outputs: native multi-intraday HTML with one card per actual trading date; JSON receipt preserves coverage
cachePolicy: no server memory/disk market-data cache; only explicitly requested report artifacts
unsupported: arbitrary historical dates outside recent five sessions

quoteHeader.previousClose: Verified preceding session close; missing reference renders no daily change. Never substitute open.
quoteHeader.layout: 60px header, 20px safe insets, name/code left, quote right; no visible date suffix or scroll hint
quoteHeader.colors: CN red up ↑, green down ↓, gray flat —
quoteHeader.columns: Actual-count local JEV rowCounts with model receipt; mobile default 1
quoteHeader.priceSeries: Line, gradient area, legend and latest price marker share verified previous-close direction
